name: Wells Fargo Autograph Journey℠ Card

tripCancellation.notes: Up to $15,000 reimbursement per covered trip for trip cancellation and interruption when you pay for travel with this card.

lostBaggage.notes: Lost baggage reimbursement when travel is purchased with the card.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel Accident Insurance included as a Visa Signature benefit when common carrier fare is charged to card.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (secondary). Decline the CDW at the rental counter.

airlineCredit.notes: $50 annual statement credit with a $50 minimum airline purchase. Available at the start of each anniversary year. Applies to airfare purchases directly with airlines.

otherCredits.name: Cell Phone Protection
otherCredits.notes: Up to $1,000 in coverage (maximum 2 claims per 12-month period, $25 deductible per claim) for cell phone damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Wells Fargo Rewards Points per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 5x on hotels booked directly with hotels; 4x on airfare booked directly with airlines; 3x on other travel

pointValue.transferPartners: Transfer partners include Aer Lingus, Air France/KLM, British Airways, Avianca, Singapore Airlines, Choice Hotels, and others at 1:1 ratio.

travelPerks: 4x points on airfare (booked directly with airlines)
3x points on other travel and dining
Secondary auto rental collision damage waiver
$1,000 cell phone protection ($25 deductible) when paying phone bill with card
Autograph Card Exclusives — special concert and entertainment access
Transfer to Wells Fargo travel partners at 1:1 ratio
bestFor: Frequent travelers who want best-in-class hotel and airfare earning rates without booking through a portal, plus a $50 airline credit that nearly covers the annual fee
